test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

__Major hubs of__ the information technology industry is the Silicon Valley of Central California.
solution:
The correct answer is **A major hub of**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **A major hub of** should replace **major hubs of**.
 
• **A major hub** is used for Silicon Valley of Central California and therefore, it should be used in the **singular form**.
 
• Thus, there should be a** subject-verb agreement**.
 
• Also, the use of **a major hub** is more suitable with** is**.
 
• Thus, the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence is **option 2**.
